phase: 5C.13 smooth echo assignment and continuation investigation

model.direct_model_and_gauges: Unchanged C11 83-parameter model, m1 origin, m2 positive x, m3 in xy positive y, e1=0.
model.echo_observations: 390 sorted storage values used only as unlabeled sets of six within each microphone/source event group.
model.marginals: Each group uses six predicted paths and six observations with uniform row/column marginal 1/6; transport mass sums to one.
model.regularized_objective_per_group: L_tau = 6*(sum_ab P_ab*C_ab + tau*KL(P || U)), U_ab=1/36; P minimizes the expression over the balanced transport polytope.
model.residual_embedding: Smooth least-squares uses one nonnegative residual sqrt(L_tau) per mic/source group; direct residual rows remain the original c-scaled values. This preserves the stated sum-of-squares objective exactly.
model.entropy_in_objective: Yes. The KL-to-uniform transport entropy penalty is included; the data-only expected matching cost is also reported separately.
model.zero_temperature_limit: As tau tends to zero, optimal P concentrates on a minimum-cost permutation and 6*sum(P*C) tends to the exact minimum sum of six squared matching errors; tau*KL tends to zero. No equivalence is claimed at finite tau.
model.assignment_derivative: Envelope derivative: dL/dx = 6*sum_ab P_ab*dC_ab/dx. Path arrival derivatives are analytic C12 derivatives restored to physical wall order. Sinkhorn uses log-domain updates.
model.hard_assignment: Hungarian minimum-cost one-to-one assignment used to count assignment changes; exact reference objective remains sorted squared error (equivalent scalar assignment).
